items.text: Bears officially ruled out Caleb Williams (hamstring) for Monday Night vs Eagles. Tyson Bagent listed questionable after practicing.
items.why: Official team report; Schefter primary, Rapoport corroborates Bagent progress to Q.
items.implication: Bears QB uncertainty (Bagent or Keenum); pass-catchers volume risk/reward on MNF.
items.opportunity: If Bagent plays, potential checkdown upside for RBs/TEs; otherwise limited offense.

items.text: Puka Nacua listed DOUBTFUL (hip) on ETR Sunday injury report; not expected to play. Davante Adams projected for elevated routes/targets.
items.why: ETR full IN/Q/D/OUT parse; McVay notes limited progress; Schefter/Rap corroborate not expected.
items.implication: Adams becomes clear WR1 with high target share; avoid Nacua weekly.
items.opportunity: Adams 42% target rate on routes without Nacua historically; massive air yards bump.

items.text: Nico Collins OUT (hamstring). Dalton Schultz saw 28% target share in prior absence; strong TE streamer vs IND.
items.why: ETR OUT list + Schefter confirmed; Grade 1 strain.
items.implication: Schultz clear TE1 upside; Texans WR depth elevated short-term.
items.opportunity: Schultz team-high targets last with Collins out; IND allows high TE yards.

items.text: Rico Dowdle OUT; Steelers RB coach says Jaylen Warren will lead the group with breather backups. Levitan projects heavy checkdowns as vertical game stalled for Rodgers.
items.why: Coach comment + ETR OUT; Levitan player-specific on lead + checkdown spam.
items.implication: Warren RB2/flex with volume spike; start confidently if projected in (Q shoulder).
items.opportunity: Lead carries + pass-game work; Homer/Heidenreich only depth.

items.text: Colts placed Alec Pierce on IR (heel); Josh Downs target share jumped to 36% and expanded outside slot.
items.why: Rapoport official; ETR OUT; Berry notes Downs perimeter routes.
items.implication: Downs WR3/flex bump; Colts WR hierarchy clear short-term.
items.opportunity: Downs 36% share post-Pierce exit; route diversity up.

items.text: Levitan projecting Jaylen Warren (shoulder), Mike Evans (hip), Brock Bowers (knee) IN despite QUESTIONABLE tags; clarity hoped on Flowers/Moore early.
items.why: Player-specific ETR projection update on injury list; DFS implications noted.
items.implication: Start Warren/Evans/Bowers as if active; monitor Flowers more closely (closer to D).
items.opportunity: Full projected roles if cleared; Warren lead already locked.

items.text: JK Dobbins and RJ Harvey both IN (hip/hamstring cleared). Broncos backfield both active.
items.why: ETR IN list; full practice progress.
items.implication: Committee continues; neither pure lead but both viable if volume splits favor.
items.opportunity: Both available; monitor snap/carry split vs prior.

items.text: Malik Nabers IN (shoulder) and Travis Etienne IN (hamstring). Nabers expected full with Winston; Etienne still committee.
items.implication: Nabers must-start WR1 upside; Etienne flex only per role limits.
items.opportunity: Nabers high target ceiling; Etienne 49% touches/38% 3rd-down snaps.

items.text: Jonathon Brooks to IR (core); Chuba Hubbard firmly lead back (RB14 util), AJ Dillon primary backup.
items.why: Berry Love/Hate news + ETR OUT/IR; surgery expected.
items.implication: Hubbard every-week starter ROS; clear handcuff Dillon.
items.opportunity: Hubbard already high utilization; full lead role locked.

items.text: Levitan: Davante Adams ran 142 routes without Nacua as Ram, targeted on 42%. Results without him: big games including 8-195-2 vs NYG.
items.why: Player-specific data/conclusion on target rate and production when Nacua absent.
items.implication: Adams elite WR1 this week and any Nacua absence.

items.text: Berry LOVES Derrick Henry vs DAL (Brazil): highest rush yards prop (88.5); DAL 30th rush D allowing 173.5 ypg.
items.opportunity: Volume + weak run D; goal-line work.

items.text: Berry LOVES Chase Brown @ PIT: 20+ touches + 15% targets both games; RB7 utilization; PIT allows 5th-most rush ypg to RBs.
Berry LOVES Chris Olave (double-digit targets, 53% air yards vs LV high YPR), Dalton Schultz (28% share sans Collins vs IND TE-friendly), Christian Watson (WR8 util, 38% RZ share).
items.why: Per-player Love split; usage + matchup data.
items.implication: Start all three; Schultz streamer priority.
items.opportunity: Olave aDOT/air yards; Schultz vacuum; Watson RZ.

items.text: Berry HATES Travis Etienne (only 49% touches/38% 3rd-down snaps even with Kamara), Rhamondre Stevenson (31% snaps/5 touches post-fumble, tough JAX), Terry McLaurin (SEA fewest WR fantasy pts, low team total).
items.conflict: ETR has Etienne IN but role limits align with hate.
